newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberia made 7-month net profit - Irala.
newsitem.headline: Iberia made 7-month net profit - Irala.

text.p: Iberia made a net profit of 4.8 billion pesetas in July, taking its net result for the first seven months of the year into black figures for the first time in many years, chairman Xabier de Irala said in a letter to employees.
"Iberia obtained a profit of 4.803 billion pesetas after tax in the month of July. In the same month last year the result was a negative 6.091 billion pesetas," the letter said.
"The accumulated (net) result for the year to July is 3.204 billion pesetas in the black -- 17 billion more than in the same period last year," it added.
Iberia is forecasting a full year net profit of 19 billion pesetas. It last registered a profit in 1989 and last year lost 45 billion pesetas net.

Sources at the airline say contacts are continuing with potential partners among other major U.S. and European carriers. They could not confirm a report in El Mundo newspaper at the weekend saying Iberia was close to a deal with Dutch flag carrier KLM, although KLM and British Airways are the two European airlines with whom Iberia has had the most extensive talks about a possible alliance.
